override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Elegg is an MG/Electric/Supporter/Burst II whose whole damage kit keys off a self-inflicted enemy status: her burst opens a 10 s 'BOOM Install' window (modeled as a name-keyed targetStatus), and BOTH rider lines (S1 100-hit distributed nuke, S2 60-hit team ATK grant) are gated on the boss carrying that status, so they can only fire inside those windows. S2's second line is a battery-opening 100% burst-gauge fill, modeled as a battle-start passive (once-per-battle). Her S1 anti-projectile buff and her burst's enemy DEF ▼ are recorded but unmodeled — neither has a channel in the current effect schema (no enemy projectiles in v1; no enemy-DEF StatKey). Distributed-damage flavor is used on the S1 rider so her own burst's distributedDamagePct buff feeds it.

skill1: When attacking an enemy projectile, damage dealt to that projectile ▲ 59.66% continuously.

caveats: ⚑ S1 GATE READING: 'Affects the target and 2 surrounding enemy unit(s) if the target is in BOOM Install' is parsed LITERALLY — the if-clause gates the whole activation, so the 158.65% distributed rider fires only while BOOM Install is live (requiresTargetStatus). Alternate reading: the rider always hits the primary target and BOOM Install merely ADDS the 2-enemy spread. On the partless single-target scope-lock boss the two readings differ only in HOW OFTEN the rider fires — a large damage delta. UNMEASURED.

⚑ DISTRIBUTED SPLIT-vs-MERGE: 158.65% is modeled as landing in FULL on the single boss. If Distributed Damage divides the stated total across the 'target + 2 surrounding' target set even when fewer enemies exist, the true per-hit value is ~1/3. Kit-silent; popup-read required.

⚑ BURST-GAUGE FILL: the once-per-battle 100% fill is keyed to a `passive` trigger (the schema's battle-start channel). This is load-bearing for the whole rotation — if the engine re-applies passive-block effects rather than resolving them once at setup, this grants unbounded gauge. Verify one fillGauge application at frame 0, then never again.

⚑ ENEMY DEF ▼ 35.64% (10 s) is UNMODELED: the effect schema has no enemy-DEF channel ('defPct' is documented self-scoped and inert; 'damageTakenPct' is a different bucket and would over-credit). The 10 s BOOM Install WINDOW is modeled (targetStatus) because the S1/S2 gates depend on it — only the DEF magnitude is dropped. This under-credits the team's damage inside her burst window by whatever the boss-DEF term is worth.

⚑ CADENCE: hitCount thresholds of 100 (S1) and 60 (S2) convert to wall-clock via the MG pull rate / 300-round belt / 171-frame reload — all datamine-unreliable fields. Rider frequency, hence her whole contribution, scales directly with that tuple.
S1 anti-projectile buff (59.66%) is inert by scope: v1 models no enemy projectiles and the scope-lock boss offers no shootable projectile. Recorded, not skipped for convenience.

Burst-cast damage (316.66%) carries no `noFb` — it is FB-exempt by CAST TIMING (the cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens), which the engine handles; setting noFb would be an unmeasured per-kit override.
Crit eligibility of both damage lines is left to the engine default (flat-damage rider crit is an engine-global policy, not a kit-stated property of this unit).

flags.estimate: GATED — rider fires only while BOOM Install is live (≈10 s per Elegg burst)
flags.reasoning: Literal parse: 'Affects [the target and 2 surrounding enemy unit(s)] if [the target is in BOOM Install]' — the conditional modifies the whole Affects clause. The competing reading (status only adds the 2-enemy spread; base target always hit) would let the 100-hit rider fire freely all fight, a multi-fold damage difference on a single-target boss.
flags.recipe: Record a fight with Elegg and timestamp every Elegg distributed-damage popup against her burst casts. If distributed popups appear >10 s after any Elegg burst, the gate is WRONG — drop requiresTargetStatus from skill1[0].

flags.estimate: 158.65 (full stated value lands on the single boss)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ split-vs-merge. 'Distributed Damage' over a 'target + 2 surrounding' set may be a total that divides across the set regardless of how many enemies are present; on a partless single boss that would make the true per-hit ~52.9%.
flags.recipe: Read the Elegg distributed popup value from footage and divide by her final ATK; compare the quotient against 1.5865 vs 0.5288.

flags.estimate: one 100% gauge fill applied at frame 0, never again
flags.reasoning: The kit says 'when the stage target appears … once per battle', but the schema has no once-per-battle primitive; `passive` is the battle-start channel. If the engine dispatches passive-block effects on a recurring tick, this becomes an unbounded gauge source and the entire burst rotation is invalid.
flags.recipe: Run controlComp with Elegg and count `fillGauge`-driven gauge jumps via cfg.onEvent / DBG_GAUGE — expect exactly one at frame 0. Cross-check the first Full Burst timestamp against footage (a battle-open FB should land far earlier than gauge accrual alone allows).

flags.estimate: 0 damage credited (schema gap), true value = whatever a 35.64% boss-DEF cut is worth in the (ATK − enemyDEF) term for 10 s
flags.reasoning: Enemy DEF reduction is genuinely damage-relevant for the WHOLE team, not a defensive throwaway, but no StatKey routes to the boss's DEF. Encoding it as damageTakenPct would put it in the wrong bucket at the wrong magnitude — a fudge.
flags.recipe: Derive the boss-DEF term from docs/data/damage-calculation.md, compute the team-wide uplift of a 35.64% cut at scope-lock ATK values, and if non-trivial open an engine request for an enemy-DEF channel before treating this override as complete.

flags.estimate: 100 and 60 landed rounds; wall-clock cadence follows the datamined MG tuple (300 belt, 171-frame reload)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and the effective rate is quantized to 60 fps frame boundaries. Rider frequency — and therefore both riders' total contribution — is linear in this tuple. Compounded here because the riders are ALSO gated to a 10 s window: whether 100 hits are even reachable inside one BOOM Install window depends entirely on the true pull rate.
flags.recipe: Ammo-counter read from footage (rounds consumed per second across a full belt) — the instrument that measures the disputed quantity directly, not FB counts.

flags.estimate: engine default (no explicit crit flag set on either damage effect)
flags.reasoning: The kit text states nothing about critical behaviour for either the distributed rider or the burst hit; flat-damage rider crit is governed by an engine-global policy, so setting crit per-kit here would be an unmeasured invention.
flags.recipe: Popup colour read (orange + icon = crit) on Elegg's distributed and burst popups across several fights; only then set an explicit crit flag.

flags.estimate: Elegg's own burst is the ONLY source in this kit — both riders are dead until her first burst
flags.reasoning: Statuses are name-keyed, so no unrelated kit opens this gate. Consequence: Elegg contributes essentially zero rider damage before her first Burst II cast, and her rider uptime is bounded by her 20 s burst cooldown against 10 s windows (≤50% uptime, less in practice).
flags.recipe: Confirm no other roster unit inflicts a status literally named 'BOOM Install'; then verify in a rotation log that skill1/skill2 rider events cluster strictly inside the 10 s post-Elegg-burst windows.
